summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Arroba Engagement System - Iteration 5. All 28 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified DealPage engagement status, LOI upgrade CTA, Save/Follow button, and DealManagement Comparator tab with shortlist/reject/exclusivity actions. All requested features are working correctly.

backend: GET /api/engagements/my-status/{dealId} - Buyer with engagement sees status (type, stage, engagement_id)
GET /api/engagements/deal/{dealId} - Returns engagements, shortlisted_buyer_ids, exclusive_buyer_id, totals
Event tracking active (INTEREST_VIEWED tracked on comparator view)
frontend: Login page loads with email/password form
DealPage shows NDA badge (data-testid='nda-badge') for buyers with NDA
DealPage shows 'Mejorar oferta (LOI)' CTA for buyers with INTEREST
DealPage LOI form (data-testid='loi-form') appears after clicking upgrade CTA
DealManagement shows exclusivity notice when deal is in exclusivity

seed_data_creation: Used existing test accounts. Created new test buyers during pytest for interest submission testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All engagement features are working. Key verified features: 1) Interest submission requires NDA first, 2) LOI upgrade from existing Interest, 3) Shortlist max 3 buyers, 4) Exclusivity blocks new engagements, 5) Save/Follow deals, 6) Seller Comparator view with table showing all engagements. The deal deal_1aa56a9545ba is currently in 'exclusivity' status which blocks new interest submissions. buyer_test@arroba.com has LOI (eng_4b2ead997b64) and is shortlisted. buyer2_test@arroba.com has interest (eng_db8f78e8d97c).

interest_submission.behavior: Requires NDA, blocks duplicates, blocks during exclusivity

loi_upgrade.behavior: Upgrades INTEREST to LOI with valuation_offer, structure, conditions

buyer_engagement_status.behavior: Returns has_engagement, type, stage, valuation details

seller_comparator.behavior: Returns all engagements, auto-marks SUBMITTED as VIEWED, includes shortlist/exclusivity info

shortlist.behavior: Max 3 buyers, updates engagement stage to SHORTLISTED

reject_buyer.behavior: Sets engagement stage to REJECTED, removes from shortlist

exclusivity.behavior: Grants exclusivity, changes deal status, blocks new engagements

save_follow_deal.behavior: Save/unsave deals, check status, list saved deals

frontend_deal_page.behavior: Shows engagement status, LOI upgrade CTA, Save button, Infomemo post-NDA

frontend_comparator.behavior: Table with Buyer, Estado, Rango/Oferta, Operación, Fecha, Acciones. Sort by date/valuation. Shortlist/Reject/Exclusivity buttons.
